item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-06127bc1dbe8cbf4","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In August 2023, Rooppur Unit 1 received installation of its passive heat removal system, designed to remove reactor-core heat without any power supply; the plant uses two VVER-1200 reactors and Russia supplies and will take back the fuel for processing.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.10","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023, though the report describes project implementation rather than Hasina's personal decision.","ruler_attribution":"The project was pursued under the Bangladesh government led by Sheikh Hasina; the report attributes technical details to Rosatom.","limitations":["No evidence here of Hasina's personal oversight, inspection, funding adequacy, or correction of failures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-88748de2ef492393","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Before Rooppur fuel delivery in September 2023, Bangladesh planned air and road transport under strict security, with army-designed protocols, armed-forces, fire-service, health-service and ambulance escorts. The IAEA conducted safeguards training, received self-assessment reports, visited the plant, and planned a monitoring cell; an expert nevertheless reported that Bangladesh lacked insurance coverage for the transport.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.4","1B.6","1B.7","1B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Measures were undertaken by Bangladeshi state agencies during Hasina's premiership; the report does not attribute the decisions directly to her.","limitations":["The source records planned safeguards and an identified insurance gap, but not outcomes, enforcement, or remedial action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d4bddffa3731c3ee","start_unit":3,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Bangladesh had signed and ratified the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, in force since 2021, maintained an IAEA comprehensive safeguards agreement and additional protocol, promoted universal adherence, and participated in the treaty's second meeting of states parties in 2023. In 2023 Bangladesh urged remaining states to ratify it.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.5","1B.6","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The treaty status predates 2023, while participation and advocacy are directly documented for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source describes Bangladesh's official position and actions under Hasina's government; it also reports Hasina's stated commitment to complete disarmament.","limitations":["ICAN is an advocacy organization; the material does not establish implementation quality beyond treaty status, safeguards, and diplomatic positions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-21cdd0089e162288","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"At the October 2023 Rooppur fuel-handling ceremony, Hasina said Russia had agreed to take spent fuel back under a bilateral agreement; she said the plant was designed to withstand disasters, that Bangladesh had enacted the Atomic Energy Regulatory Act, established an independent regulatory authority working with the IAEA, and created a statutory company to manage the plant. She also reaffirmed commitment to nuclear-weapons elimination and the TPNW.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.3","1B.4","1B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct statement and claimed actions by Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["Most safety and implementation claims are reported by Hasina or government-linked ceremony participants; no independent performance audit is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-55af11940e44716b","start_unit":7,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"For the FY2023-24 budget, Hasina called for conservative spending despite upcoming elections, prioritizing inflation control and stability, limiting nonessential expenditure, shifting emphasis toward education, health and agriculture, speeding project implementation, restraining subsidies, expanding safety-net coverage, and reserving funds for emergency targeted subsidies. Earlier austerity restrictions had been partly relaxed, and officials acknowledged weak implementation rates.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","5B.7","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023 budget planning; some measures concern FY2023-24 implementation beyond the period.","ruler_attribution":"The report directly attributes the priorities and instructions to Hasina, based partly on finance-ministry officials.","limitations":["The source documents instructions and budget design, not executed spending, distributional incidence, or achieved outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-02fab71cbf40b9a4","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"In January 2023 Hasina rejected allegations of corruption in mega-projects and challenged an opposition MP to provide concrete proof; she also said authorities were acting against hoarders, black-market operators and LC irregularities. She presented an 11-point future target including Smart Bangladesh, transformation of villages, basic needs, education and healthcare, while asserting that the Awami League retained public trust and that no force could unseat it.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.3","4B.6","5B.5","5B.7","6B.1","6B.2","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct parliamentary statements by Hasina.","limitations":["Her rejection of corruption allegations is not independently verified here; the 11-point target is a stated program rather than evidence of implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b1148990add0745d","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"In April 2023 Hasina accused the United States of seeking to install a non-democratic government and criticized opposition support for US democracy messaging. She defended constitutional Article 70 as protecting governmental stability and said the Awami League had narrowed rural-urban gaps and improved development indicators, citing lower poverty and child and maternal mortality between 2006 and 2022.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.8","4B.10","5B.10","6B.10","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023, with outcome comparisons extending back to 2006 and ending in 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Direct parliamentary statements by Hasina.","limitations":["The source provides no independent verification of the political claims or cited development figures; it does not show whether Article 70 constrained or enabled democratic accountability in practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-70c3ab32dc0253f8","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"At an October 2023 rally, Hasina dismissed BNP threats to remove her government, described BNP-Jamaat as killers, looters and terrorists, and contrasted it with the Awami League's claims of peace and development. At the same event she inaugurated the 9.39-kilometre Bangabandhu tunnel, costing Tk 10,689 crore, and inaugurated 11 completed projects while launching six more.","question_ids":["3B.3","4B.2","4B.3","4B.10","5B.6","8B.1","8B.3","8B.6","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct statements and inaugurations by Hasina at a ruling-party rally.","limitations":["The report does not establish whether the rhetoric caused violence or whether the projects met cost, quality, or distributional objectives."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-a1c33c309656c008","SRC-810968326001eb49","SRC-9ba27dee2970a389","SRC-c878dab3dd2b1a66"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents concern periods outside 2023-2023 and were excluded where they did not provide a material fact about Hasina during the target period.","The supplied materials contain limited independent evidence on courts, elections, conflict conduct, corruption findings, social-service incidence, and end-period outcomes."]}
